given: a Staff Member holding rates.manage with reach to the Property
when: they save a nightly price for rooms
then: the price is stored in the Property's currency and names who set it; the Rates section shows it
test_name: a_price_is_set_in_the_propertys_currency

given: a room price exists
when: a second room price is written
then: refused by the unique key on the Property and the type; the module turns a save into a change of the one price
test_name: one_price_per_type_at_a_property

given: any Staff Member who may set prices
when: they price a kind of Unit accommodation_units does not allow
then: refused by the check constraint on the type
test_name: a_kind_of_unit_that_cannot_exist_has_no_price

given: any Staff Member who may set prices
when: they save 0, a negative amount, a fraction of a minor unit, or more than 10^11 minor units
then: refused by the check constraint and first by the module, naming the type; clearing is how a type goes unpriced, never a price of 0
test_name: rates.test.sql: RT-S1-04: a price of nothing is refused; rates.test.sql: RT-S1-04: and so is one past the ceiling; rates.test.ts: a_malformed_price_is_refused_before_the_database

given: ranza_app
when: it writes a price
then: the grants name the Property, the type and the amount; only the amount changes afterwards; the currency, the author and the times are the trigger's
test_name: rates.test.sql: RT-S1-05: a price names its Property, its type and its amount, and nothing else; rates.test.sql: RT-S1-05: and only its amount changes afterwards; rates.test.sql: RT-S1-05: a price is not moved to another type; rates.test.sql: RT-S1-05: nor told who set it; rates.test.sql: RT-S1-01: a price is set, in the Property's currency, and names who set it

given: a Property trading in TRY
when: a caller tries to state a price in USD
then: refused: the currency is not granted, and the trigger overwrites it with the Property's for every role
test_name: a_caller_cannot_name_the_currency

given: a Property with prices and nothing that fixes its currency
when: its currency is changed
then: the prices stay in the old currency and are shown stale; they price nothing until set again, which restates them in the new currency; the list's version changes so an open form cannot save amounts typed in the old one
test_name: rates.test.sql: RT-S1-07: a currency change leaves the price in the old currency, stale; rates.test.sql: RT-S1-07: and setting it again states it in the Property's currency; rates.test.sql: RT-S2-04: a price left in an old currency prices no booking; rates.test.ts: a_currency_change_makes_the_list_stale_and_saving_restates_it

given: the shipped roles
when: rates.manage is granted
then: Owner and Manager hold it; Front Desk, Finance and Housekeeping do not; an Organization's own role may include it within its author's own permissions (SP-S1-34)
test_name: owner_and_manager_hold_rates_manage

given: a Staff Member reaching the Property without rates.manage
when: they open Configuration or take a booking
then: they read the price list
test_name: the_front_desk_reads_the_price_it_quotes

given: a Staff Member reaching the Property without rates.manage
when: they set, change or clear a price
then: refused by the write policies; an update or delete matches no row and the module reports a refusal
test_name: rates.test.sql: RT-S1-10: without rates.manage a price is not set; rates.test.sql: RT-S1-10: nor changed; rates.test.sql: RT-S1-10: nor cleared; rates.test.ts: the_front_desk_reads_and_is_refused

given: a manager of another Organization
when: they read or set this Property's prices
then: nothing is visible and nothing is written
test_name: rates.test.sql: RT-S1-11: another Organization's prices are not seen; rates.test.sql: RT-S1-11: nor set

given: a manager assigned to one Property
when: they price another Property of the Organization
then: refused
test_name: a_property_out_of_reach_is_not_priced

given: a room price exists
when: they empty the field and save
then: the price is emptied, never deleted: the row keeps no amount, the type is unpriced, and the audit record keeps what it was
test_name: a_price_is_cleared

given: the Organization's Subscription is suspended
when: they set or change a price
then: refused by the commercial gates in the write policies
test_name: a_lapsed_subscription_sets_no_price

given: a Staff Member without rates.manage
when: they open the Rates section
then: every price is shown formatted in their language, no field or Save is offered, and one line says who can change them
test_name: a_reader_sees_prices_and_changes_none

given: two managers read the same list
when: both save
then: serialised per Property; the second is told the list changed and is shown what is now saved, rather than undoing the first
test_name: two_saves_from_one_version_do_not_both_land

given: a manager typing in Turkish, English or Arabic
when: they type 1750,5 or 1750.5 or Arabic digits
then: it is read as minor units of the Property's currency by the rule every money field uses; more decimals than the currency has is refused at the field, which keeps what was typed and takes focus
test_name: an_unreadable_price_is_refused_at_the_field_and_kept

given: a Property with no Units of a kind
when: the Rates section is shown
then: the kind is listed as having none yet and may still be priced
test_name: rates_section_lists_every_kind_with_its_price_and_units

given: any save that changes a price
when: it commits
then: one price_list.changed audit record at the Property with each type's price before and after
test_name: prices_are_set_and_audited_before_and_after

given: a room price of 1500.00 TRY
when: a Guest booking is taken for a room
then: the database stamps the booking with 150000 and TRY from the Unit's type; no caller supplies either
test_name: a_guest_booking_is_stamped_with_its_types_price

given: a booking priced at 1500.00
when: the room price is changed to 1750.00
then: the booking still carries 1500.00; nothing re-prices a booking
test_name: a_booking_keeps_the_price_it_was_taken_at

given: no bed price is set
when: a Guest booking is taken for a bed
then: the booking is taken unpriced; the dialog said so before it was taken; the front desk is never blocked by an unset price list
test_name: rates.test.sql: RT-S2-03: a kind with no price is booked unpriced, not refused; rates.spec.ts: a kind with no price says so before a booking is taken

given: a room price left in TRY after the Property moved to EUR
when: a Guest booking is taken for a room
then: the booking is unpriced: a price in money the Property does not trade in applies to nothing
test_name: rates.test.sql: RT-S2-04: a price left in an old currency prices no booking

given: any price list
when: a Resident booking is taken
then: it is never priced by the night; a Resident is billed monthly, which is deferred (RT-DEF-04)
test_name: rates.test.sql: RT-S2-05: a Resident is never priced by the night; rates.test.sql: RT-S2-05: a Resident priced by the night is refused even without the stamp

given: ranza_app, or a role that bypasses policies
when: it supplies or later changes a booking's price
then: refused: the columns are granted to nobody, the stamp overwrites any value on insert for every role, and a change afterwards is refused for every role
test_name: rates.test.sql: RT-S2-06: a caller cannot name a booking's price; rates.test.sql: RT-S2-06: nor change it; rates.test.sql: RT-S2-06: and a role that bypasses every policy cannot change it either; rates.test.sql: RT-S2-06: whatever such a role supplies is overwritten by the price list, not kept

situation: A priced booking fixes the currency
given: a Property with no Folio and a requested, confirmed or checked-in priced booking
when: its currency is changed
then: refused as a Folio already does (ADR 0036 amended); the Configuration screen shows the currency locked with the reason
test_name: a_priced_booking_fixes_the_currency

situation: A booking racing a currency change
given: a booking and a currency change at the same moment
when: both commit
then: serialised on the Property row: either the currency changed first and the booking is priced in it or unpriced, or the booking is priced and the change is refused
test_name: a_booking_and_a_currency_change_serialise

given: a front desk choosing a Unit and dates
when: the New reservation dialog is filled in
then: it shows the price per night and the total for the nights chosen; an open-ended booking shows the price per night only; unpriced says the nights will not be charged; a Resident says billed monthly
test_name: the_booking_dialog_quotes_the_price_and_total

given: bookings priced and unpriced
when: the Reservations list is shown
then: each shows its price per night, or No price
test_name: RT-S2-10: shows a priced booking's price per night and an unpriced one's No price

given: Reservations that exist when this is deployed
when: it is deployed
then: they stay unpriced; nothing is backfilled, because a price nobody quoted is not one somebody agreed
test_name: RT-S2-11: a booking taken before its kind had a price stays unpriced; nothing is backfilled

given: a desk quoted 1500.00 and a manager then changed the price, cleared it, or changed the currency
when: the booking is taken
then: refused as a price that changed, and nothing is written: the dialog reads the price again, so a Guest is never charged a price nobody told them
test_name: a_booking_quoted_at_a_price_that_changed_is_refused

situation: The quote tells a Resident's truth
given: a front desk booking or extending a Resident
when: the New reservation, Change booking or Change departure dialog quotes, or Analytics or Close the day explains Resident nights
then: it says a Resident is not charged by the night and that Finance posts their rent to the Folio, never that they are billed monthly, because nothing bills a Resident yet (RT-DEF-04); amends the wording of RT-S2-09's last clause, which stays approved as written until this row is
test_name: the_booking_dialog_quotes_the_price_and_total; change-departure.test.tsx: a Resident's extension is not called free: Finance posts their rent

situation: A night is charged at the close
given: a Guest in house through the night of D on a priced booking with an open Folio
when: D is closed by hand or by the worker
then: one charge of the booked price, dated D and marked a room night, is posted to their Folio inside the close; the close records it
test_name: the_close_posts_one_room_night_per_guest

given: D's room nights are posted
when: the close is retried, raced by another closer, or a check-out posts the same night
then: nothing new is posted: a room night is unique per Folio and business date
test_name: room_nights.test.sql: RT-S3-02: a room night is unique per Folio and business date; room_nights.test.sql: RT-S3-02: and asked again, nothing is charged twice; room_nights.test.sql: RT-S3-02: nor twice for one Folio and date, whoever writes it

given: room nights dated D exist, whoever posted them
when: D closes
then: the close records the count and total of every room night dated D, and how many nights it could not charge; Guest nights occupied equal posted plus unposted
test_name: the_close_records_every_room_night_dated_its_day

situation: A night that cannot be charged
given: a Guest in house on an unpriced booking, a Stay with no booking, a Property without billing, a Folio closed, or a price in another currency
when: D closes
then: nothing is posted for that Stay; the close lists it with the reason and never blocks on it, so the worker still closes a quiet day
test_name: room_nights.test.sql: RT-S3-04: and lists the nights it could not charge, with why; room_nights.test.sql: RT-S3-04: never as items left open, so they block nothing

given: a Resident in house
when: D closes
then: no room night: Residents are billed monthly (deferred)
test_name: room_nights.test.sql: RT-S3-04, RT-S3-05: every Guest night of T-1 with why it cannot be charged

situation: Check-out charges what the close has not
given: a Guest checking out on T whose night of T-1 is not closed yet
when: the desk reviews and confirms check-out
then: the review shows the nights not yet charged and their amount; the confirmation posts them, then settles or leaves the balance with a reason; the later close of T-1 posts nothing for them
test_name: check_out_charges_the_nights_not_yet_charged

given: nights were charged, or the business date rolled, between the review and the confirmation
when: check-out is confirmed
then: refused as a changed bill (ADR 0030 amended): what was posted must equal what was reviewed, count and amount
test_name: check_out_refuses_nights_it_did_not_show

given: a close of D holding the Property's day and a check-out of a Guest in house that night
when: both run
then: no deadlock: every path takes the Unit, then the Property's day, then the Stay; one waits for the other and the check-out is re-reviewed if the close charged first
test_name: a_close_and_a_check_out_do_not_deadlock

situation: Posting to a closed or future day
given: any caller, including one bypassing policies
when: a room night is dated on a closed day, on today or later
then: refused: a night is charged only for a day that has ended and has not been finalized without it
test_name: room_nights.test.sql: RT-S3-09: today has not ended, so its nights are not charged; room_nights.test.sql: RT-S3-09: a room night is never dated on a closed day, even by a role that bypasses policies; room_nights.test.sql: RT-S3-09: nor on a day that has not ended; room_nights.test.sql: RT-S3-09: a closed day's nights are not posted again

given: a Staff Member without front_desk.close_day or front_desk.check_out, or a worker of another Organization
when: they call the posting function
then: refused; posting is the close's and the check-out's act, not finance.post_charge's
test_name: room_nights.test.sql: RT-S3-10: a Staff Member who may not check a Guest out posts nothing for them; room_nights.test.sql: RT-S3-10: nor a day's nights, without front_desk.close_day; room_nights.test.sql: RT-S3-10: a Staff Member cannot mark a charge a room night by hand; room_nights.test.sql: RT-S3-10: posting outside a request or the worker is refused

given: a room night reversed by finance
when: the day is closed again or the Guest checks out
then: it is not posted again; the reversal carries no date or mark of its own
test_name: room_nights.test.sql: RT-S3-11: a reversed night is still posted; room_nights.test.sql: RT-S3-11: the close does not post a reversed night again, and the night and its reversal, which carries no date or mark, both remain; room_nights.test.sql: RT-S3-11: nor does check-out post a reversed night again; room_nights.test.sql: RT-S3-11: after check-out J still has each night once, and both reversals

given: a Guest past their planned departure, or leaving early
when: nights are charged
then: every night actually in house is charged at the booked price, and no night after they left; fees are deferred (CO-S1-31)
test_name: rates.test.ts: check_out_charges_the_nights_not_yet_charged

given: a Guest checked in and out before the cutoff on their arrival date
when: check-out is confirmed
then: no room night is charged
test_name: room_nights.test.sql: RT-S3-13: a Guest who arrived today has no night to charge

given: room nights on a Folio
when: it is read
then: each shows as a room night for its date in the reader's language
test_name: a_room_night_reads_in_every_locale

given: nights that will not be charged
when: the Close the day checklist is shown
then: they are listed by Guest with the reason before closing; a closed day shows the nights charged, and the amount to those who may see money
test_name: the_close_screen_lists_nights_it_will_not_charge

situation: A balance on every priced check-out
given: nothing can take a payment yet (check-out PRE-01)
when: a priced Guest checks out
then: the balance is left open with a reason, as ADR 0030 already allows; the dialog says payments cannot be taken yet and the Folio stays open with the balance
test_name: RT-S3-16: says payments cannot be taken yet and asks why the balance stays open

given: a Property whose billing is no longer available
when: D closes
then: nothing is posted for it and the nights are listed as billing unavailable
test_name: room_nights.test.sql: RT-S3-17: where billing is not available, a night is listed and not charged; room_nights.test.sql: RT-S3-17: and the close writes no line on that Guest's Folio

given: a room night reversed by finance before the day closes
when: the day closes
then: the close still counts it among the nights charged and its amount: the total is what was charged, not revenue net of corrections, which is a report's to compute
test_name: the_close_records_every_room_night_dated_its_day

situation: Rate plans, seasons, weekday and occupancy prices
given: a Property that prices by date or demand
when: prices are set
then: deferred: blueprint 5.16, Distribution and Revenue

situation: A price per Unit, or typed at the desk
given: a sea-view room or a negotiated price
when: a booking is taken
then: deferred: needs its own permission and audit; the general case, one price per kind, is built first

given: a booking whose dates or Unit are amended
when: it is amended
then: built with amending a booking: a booking still to come moved to another kind takes that kind's price, and one that would fall or go needs rates.manage (ADR 0039, AB-S1-03, AB-S1-28)
test_name: amend_booking.test.sql: AB-S1-03; AB-S1-28

given: a Resident in house
when: a month ends
then: deferred: monthly billing is its own feature

given: a charge that carries tax or a discount
when: a night is charged
then: deferred: blueprint 5.9 and CO-S1-31

given: a Guest paying at the desk
when: they pay
then: deferred: check-out PRE-01; until then every priced check-out leaves its balance with a reason (RT-S3-16)

situation: A bed is priced by its room
given: a Property whose price list has a price for beds in a room of one and another for a room of four, and a bed in each
when: a Guest is booked on each bed
then: each booking is stamped with the price of its room's size, so a night in the single and a night in the four-bed room cost what the fee sheet says
test_name: bed_price_by_room.test.sql: RT-S4-01: a booking in a single and one in a four-bed room are priced differently; bed-price-by-room.spec.ts: the Rates section prices each size of room, and the booking dialog quotes a bed by its room

given: a price for beds in rooms of four exists
when: a second one is written for the same Property and size, or a second general bed price
then: refused by the unique keys (23505): one price per Property, kind and size, and one general price per kind; the module turns a save into a change of the one
test_name: bed_price_by_room.test.sql: RT-S4-02: one price per size at a Property

situation: Only a bed has a size
given: a price for a room, an apartment or a suite, or a size of none or of sixty-five
when: it is written with a room size
then: refused (23514): a room is sold whole and has no room around it, and no real room sleeps more than sixty-four
test_name: bed_price_by_room.test.sql: RT-S4-03: only a bed is priced by its room's size; a room is not

situation: A size with no price takes the general bed price
given: a general bed price and no price for rooms of three
when: a Guest is booked on a bed in a room of three, or on a bed that has no room
then: the booking is stamped with the general bed price: the price for any room is what a size without one of its own falls back to
test_name: bed_price_by_room.test.sql: RT-S4-04: a size with no price of its own takes the general bed price, and so does a bed with no room

situation: Clearing a size takes the override away
given: a size price and a general bed price
when: the size price is cleared, and then the general one too
then: after the first the beds of that size take the general price; after the second a size that is still priced keeps its price and the others are booked unpriced, never refused
test_name: bed_price_by_room.test.sql: RT-S4-05: a cleared size is passed over, and its beds take the general price

given: a Property that prices rooms, apartments and suites and also beds by size
when: a room, an apartment and a suite are booked, and the price list is read
then: each is stamped with its own kind's price whatever sizes exist for beds, and no price of any other kind than a bed carries a size
test_name: bed_price_by_room.test.sql: RT-S4-06: a room, an apartment and a suite keep their own kind's price whatever sizes beds have

situation: A price set later reaches nobody already booked
given: a booking taken at a size's price
when: the size's price is changed or a new size is priced
then: the booking keeps the price it was taken at; nothing is backfilled (RT-S2-02, RT-S2-11)
test_name: bed_price_by_room.test.sql: RT-S4-07: a price set later reaches nobody already booked

situation: Moved to a room of another size
given: a booking still to come on a bed in a room of four
when: it is moved to a bed in a single, or to a bed in another room of four
then: moved to a single it takes the single's price; moved to another room of four it keeps the price it was quoted; a Guest in house keeps theirs (ADR 0039)
test_name: bed_price_by_room.test.sql: RT-S4-08: moved to a single, a booking takes the single's price; the desk may move a Guest up

given: a booking on a bed in a single moved to a bed in a room of four, which costs less
when: the desk, who holds front_desk.amend and not rates.manage, moves it, and then a Manager does
then: refused for the desk (42501) and allowed for the Manager, as a move to a cheaper kind is (AB-S1-28); a move to a dearer size is the list's and the desk may make it
test_name: bed_price_by_room.test.sql: RT-S4-09: the desk cannot move a booking to a size that costs less

situation: A stale size price prices nothing and hands nothing on
given: a size priced in a currency the Property has left and a general bed price stated in the Property's own
when: a Guest is booked on a bed of that size
then: the booking is unpriced, not charged the general price: a number nobody chose for that room (ADR 0038, a stale price prices nothing)
test_name: bed_price_by_room.test.sql: RT-S4-10: a stale size price prices nothing and hands its beds to nobody

situation: The same gates as any price
given: a front desk, a Manager of another Organization, a Manager of this one
when: each tries to set a size price, or to change which size a price is for
then: only rates.manage with reach and the commercial gates sets one; the caller names the size when the row is written and never afterwards (no update grant on room_capacity)
test_name: bed_price_by_room.test.sql: RT-S4-11: the front desk does not price a size

situation: The quote and the stamp agree
given: a bed in a room of four with a size price
when: the booking dialog quotes it and the booking is taken
then: both ask app.rate_for_unit, so the price quoted is the price stamped; a Unit in another Property answers nothing
test_name: rates.test.ts: RT-S4-12: the quote is the stamp, in a single and in a room of four

situation: The price list shows each size the Property has
given: a Property with rooms of one, three and four beds, a price for rooms of four, and a Manager
when: they open the Rates section
then: the list shows the general bed price and one row for each size that exists, in size order, with how many beds each prices; a size with no price says it takes the general one
test_name: configuration.test.tsx: RT-S4-13: lists the general bed price and one row for each size of room; rates.test.ts: RT-S4-13: the section lists the general bed price and one row for each size of room the Property has

given: a Manager changing a size's price and clearing another
when: they save
then: one save changes both, one audit record names each size with its price before and after, and a stale form is refused as before
test_name: rates.test.ts: RT-S4-14: a size price is saved and audited with its size, and clearing it says what it was

given: a Property with beds in rooms of one and four, the single priced and the general price blank
when: the section is read
then: the beds of four, which fall back to the blank general price, are the unpriced kind the section warns about; the single's are not
test_name: configuration.test.tsx: RT-S4-15: only beds that would be unpriced are warned about

situation: A price by building, floor or season
given: a yurt with a dearer block or a summer rate
when: a bed is booked
then: deferred: the general case, a bed priced by its room's size, is built; a second dimension is its own design
